exposure: LA-MRSA (spa type t127, ST1, SCCmec V)
cohort: Eighteen caesarean-derived/colostrum-deprived piglets of 35 days of age were randomly assigned to three groups for exposure to LA-MRSA.
finding: The CC1 LA-MRSA clone effectively colonized contaminated piglets and rapidly transmitted to and colonized exposed piglets, persisting throughout the study duration, suggesting good host adaptation.
followup_time: 44 days post-contamination (for Group A) or 42 days post-exposure (for Group B)
